title: E-mail · To: Training Participants · From: Helen Price · Subject: Sales training next week · Schedule · Sales Training
L: (1) E-mail · To: Training Participants · From: Helen Price · Subject: Sales training next week
Hello everyone, As announced, our two-day sales training will take place next Tuesday and Wednesday at the Lakeside Conference Center.
The attached schedule shows all sessions.
Please note that the session on customer negotiations has been moved to the afternoon of the second day because the speaker, Mr. Torres, has a flight that morning.
I'm also pleased that Raj, who joined us from Delmont Industries last month, will lead a session.
Lunch will be provided on both days.
If you have dietary needs, reply to this e-mail by Friday.
Using the new sales software (Lina Park)
